name: inbox.meta_receive
description: Keeps the comments and DMs Meta's webhook brought for one account linked through our own Meta app: each lands in the inbox of the brand that holds the account, once (Meta sends again for up to 36 hours; the message's id is made from Meta's own). An account no brand within reach holds is refused as not found. Internal: packages/connect's webhook calls it as the principal META_WEBHOOK_AS names.
sql: with a as (select a.brand_id from brandbase.accounts a where a.platform = :platform and a.account_id = :account and a.details ->> 'via' = 'meta'), ins as (insert into brandbase.inbox_messages (id, brand_id, platform, kind, from_name, from_handle, text, received_at, tone, external) select x.id, a.brand_id, case :platform when 'instagram' then 'ig' else 'fb' end, x.kind, x."fromName", x."fromHandle", x.text, x."receivedAt"::timestamptz, 'question', x.external from a, jsonb_to_recordset(:items::jsonb) as x(id text, kind text, "fromName" text, "fromHandle" text, text text, "receivedAt" text, external jsonb) on conflict (id) do nothing returning 1) select jsonb_build_object('brand', (select brand_id from a), 'stored', (select count(*) from ins)) as result
